english.title: Owner of equine fail to ensure application for ID received by issuing body within time limits
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the owner of an equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), born in a member State or in the United Kingdom and located on a holding in Wales, failed to ensure that an application for an ID for that equine was received by an issuing body, being no later than 30 days prior to the final date for issuing an ID, namely **(..SPECIFY DATE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 6, 22(1) and 34 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
owner of equine born in a member State or in the United Kingdom
located on a holding in Wales
failed to ensure that an application for an ID for that equine
was received by the issuing body
on or before
31st December in the year in which the equine was born OR
6 months following the date of the equine's birth
accompanied by the fee specified by the issuing body

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the owner of an equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), born in a member State or in the United Kingdom and located on a holding in Wales, the defendant failed to ensure that an application for an ID for that equine was received by an issuing body, being no later than 30 days prior to the final date for issuing an ID, namely **(..SPECIFY DATE..).

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 monthsNote
